description: Original compact industrial field scanner: chamfered orange shell, recessed blue telemetry screen, black carry loop and three tactile controls.

review.silhouette: 144 mm wide chamfered shell; 260 mm overall height; visibly open carry loop, not a solid tab.
review.front: Display centered above three evenly spaced controls, four horizontal grille slots and four corner fasteners; green status indicator above the display.
review.finish: Orange matte casing, dark bezel/handle, blue telemetry visible through a recessed display; no orange checkerboard across the finished casing.
review.uv: Complete nondegenerate measured UV maps on shell/display, no positive-area overlaps in the tested scope, layout captures and declared texture resolution.
review.preserve: Calibration object geometry/UVs/weights/materials/transforms, factory camera/light, selection, active object and temporary capture settings remain unchanged.
review.limits: This brief does not waive paint/bake, character, simulation, production-scale, delivery, durable recovery or install/upgrade/RC requirements. Auxiliary solid-color parts are not an accepted whole-asset atlas.
